optimization.name: real-erf
optimization.description: Replace the real-valued DERF1 wrapper around complex CERROR with standard intrinsic ERF(x); CERROR and all other source bytes remain unchanged
optimization.before:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
     complex*16 zg,zgg 
!      y=DERF(x)
      zg=x
      call cerror(zg,zgg)
      DERF1=zgg
     return
     end
optimization.after:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
      DERF1=ERF(x)
     return
     end
optimization.diff:
--- DERF1.original
+++ DERF1.real-erf
@@ -1,9 +1,5 @@
      real*8 function DERF1(x)
      real*8 x
-     complex*16 zg,zgg 
-!      y=DERF(x)
-      zg=x
-      call cerror(zg,zgg)
-      DERF1=zgg
+      DERF1=ERF(x)
      return
      end

printing_fix.scope: Only the diagnostic WRITE argument; no physical arithmetic changed

primary_input_texts.IN.FLOWFACTORS:

0.001  vminF = lowest velocity for flow factors (in m/s)
12  Np = number of pressure points (max 1000)
200000.0  pmaxF = maximum nominal contact pressure
6  Npadd = added data points for large separation (Np+Npadd max 1000)
1.0  addp = added number of decades in separation using asympthotic relation for flowfactors
primary_input_texts.IN_npolyCq.npolyab.npolyE:
0  npolyCq: polynomial used for smoothing powerspectrum; =0 no smoothing
0  npolyab: smoothing shift factor a(T), b(T)
0  npolyE: smoothing viscoelastic modulus
primary_input_texts.IN.mathematical:
0.01  delzeta: step length in integration over magnification; 0.0025 good, but use maximum 0.01
3.0       xjump (mathematical): the separation \bar u/h_{rms} where you switch to asymthotic pressure flow factor; us of order 3.0
0         idonot (mathematical) =0 make flow factor continous at xjump, =1 do not make continous
0.42      percolation: contact area percolate at the realative contact area A/A0 = percolation
110       Np number of pressure points for flow factor in squeeze-out and mixed lubrication
1.0E-12   u1min: smallest separation for which height distribution calculated; must be ~ 0.001 smaller than smallest relevant length scale (could be atomic dimension)
40000     nMontestep: number of MonteCarlo steps in fitting E to time serie
30        nterm: number of relaxation time terms in fitting E to time series
0.4       UcorrectionFactor: =0.4 gives good elastic energy S=0.4+(1-0.4)*P^2
1         iubar=1 method 1 calculate baru and u1 and P(u); =0 method 0 involving direct solution of p=-dUel/du, slow method
2.0       ony used if iuber=0 or if iflag003=20 or 30:    pfraction: sigmaMax=pfraction*x*rmsslopenl; us of order 2.0
20.0      ony used if iuber=0 or if iflag003=20 or 30:    pm: delpmu=pm/(1.0*Np); use of order 20.0
4000      ony used if iuber=0 or if iflag003=20 or 30:    Npu:  pmu=delpmu*i, i=1,..,Npu;  sigma=sigmaMax*exp(-pmu); use of order 4000
512  nurange = number of data points used for interfacial separation probability distribution; max allowed 10000; if bigger needed increase Nur in IN.PARAMETER
1.0       afact = factor in expression for P(u): hrms*hrms is replaced with 1/[hrms*hrms+afact*u1*u1] 
3.1415    scaleL = factor giving load on macroasperity for Finite Size u(p); A0=(scaleL/q0)**2.0, F=pnormal*A0; standard value = pi, best value??? = 1.8 according to study with Carbone
0         iTurnOnFinite=1 include finite sice effect when calculating integrals with P(u); if =1 the P(u) for p<pFiniteSize is for p=pFiniteSize, =2 readin pFiniteSize from IN.ELECTROADHESION, only used for ELECTROADHESION
1.0       scaleC; scale the power spectrum with this factor; result in scaling hrms with sqrt(scaleC)
0.9  feedback1: during iteration for seal effective medium conductivity sigmaNEW = sigmaOLD*feedback1 +sigmaNEW*(1-feedback1); typically choose feedback1=0.99
6000  NittSeal = number of iterations to get converged flow conductivity sigma; must choose NittSeal >> 1/(1-feedback1); typically use 100000
1.0 2.2   scaleK: the finite-size stiffness scale factor of order unity; choose scaleK so that separation for p=0 is height of highest asperity; only used when iflag003>0
3.85      Ciavarella parameter about 3.85 (for H=0.9); 4.75 (H=0.7); 5.44 (H=0.5); 5.58 (H=0.3)

primary_input_texts.IN.SEALING:
1.0E+05     PressureDrop: difference in fluid pressure (in Pa) between inside and outside; applied (maximum) pressure from IN.sigma...
150         Np: number of pressure points in output
0.12        width (in cm) of rectangular seal in fluid flow direction, or diameter (in cm) of O-ring: only used if iflag008=4, 5, 40 or 50

0.0         gas pressure (in Pa) on low pressure side (for gas leakage) (1 atm is added)

2.0E-09    dmin: (for confined fluid shear friction--not used in present code)
1.0E+05    UniversalC: (for confined fluid shear friction--not used in present code)
1.0E+30 1.5E+04  1.326E+30  bthin: shear thinning parameter; use very large value to eliminate shear thinning
0.77     -0.193     cthin: shear thinning parameter; shearthin=1.0/(1.0+(viscosity/bthin)*dotgamma**cthin)
1.0        ellipsgamma: Surface anisotropy Tripp number; if ellipsgamma > 10^4 asympthotic em-formula used
1.0E-09    uboundary=minimum lubrication film thickness i.e. boundary lubrication film which cannot be squeezed out
